segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Hi Dana, this is Sam from OPSWAT support. I have your case about upload failures open. Can you walk me through what you're seeing?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Hi Sam. Our staff upload shipping documents through our portal, and anything bigger than about fifty megabytes fails after roughly a minute. Smaller files go through fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: And the portal sends files to MetaDefender ICAP Server for scanning before saving them, right?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Yes, the portal is the ICAP client. The error it logs is an ICAP 500 response, and users just see an upload failed message.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Which version of ICAP Server are you running, and which Core is it connected to?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: ICAP Server is 5.8.0, I just checked the dashboard. Core is 5.12.0. We upgraded both about two months ago.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Thanks. Do you have the ICAP Server log from one of the failed uploads? I'd like to see what it says around the failure time.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Give me a second. Okay, there's a line that says timed out waiting for Core scan result after 60 seconds, and then the 500 is returned to the portal right after that.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: That fits. Large archives can take longer than 60 seconds to scan on Core, and ICAP Server gives up at its own timeout. Are the big files mostly zip archives?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Mostly, yes. Scanned shipping manifests bundled as zips, some with a few hundred pages inside.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Okay. I haven't confirmed the exact setting yet, so I'll check the documentation for the ICAP scan timeout and for the Core archive handling limits, and send you the steps.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Sounds good. Should I raise the timeout in the meantime? I don't want to break anything.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Hold off until you have my steps, so we change one thing at a time. Meanwhile, please send the full ICAP Server log for one failed upload and the size of your largest zip.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text_original: Will do. The largest one we've seen is around eighty megabytes. I'll send the log this afternoon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text_original: Perfect. I'll follow up with the documented steps and what to test once you've applied them. Thanks, Dana.
